title: feat(runtime)!: the permission-set clone door lands "new similar" in a writable target package, by default the source package's .custom (#28563)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGSvgWmGsEvSht2WRwVcj7u)_
Fixes #28563

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `POST /security/permission-sets/:name/clone` takes an optional `package` and its answer names the package the copy landed in (widening). A copy of a set shipped by a read-only package now lands in that package's paired `<X>.custom`, ensured through the pair's one creation path, so a source whose package the ensure door refuses (no namespace, a version that is not SemVer, or the pair's namespace owned by another package) is refused 409/422 where it was copied package-less before; a given target that is unknown, read-only or out of reach is refused.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated — `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (the clone section: the `package` key, where a copy lands, the two refusals, the answer's `package`) and the `permission` row of `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`; no page under `skills/**` names the door.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the permission-set clone door (`@objectstack/runtime`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：权限集「复制」接口（`POST /security/permission-sets/:name/clone`）现在把副本放进一个可写的软件包：不指定 `package` 时，复制某个只读包 X 发布的权限集，副本落在 X 的配对定制包 `X.custom`（第一次复制时经 N-13 的 ensure 门创建，之后复用）；源权限集本就在可写包里，就落在那个包；环境里自建的权限集照旧不进任何包。指定 `package` 时，它必须已安装、可写，且其依赖闭包够得着源包和该权限集授权的每个对象，否则拒收（422 / 409），什么都不写。答复多一个 `package` 字段，说明落在哪。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28563（epic #28236 的 N-20a，维护者「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」）：以前副本不属于任何包，客户对 HotCRM 的改动导出时会漏掉它。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄只有一种：源包本身无法配对（没有 namespace、版本不是 SemVer、配对 namespace 已被别的包占用）时，以前能复制成「无包」副本，现在按 ensure 门原话拒收。showcase 与平台自带权限集（`member_default` 等）实测都能正常配对落地。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts`（第 6 步落点与保存时的 `packageId`）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/new-similar-target.ts`（与 #28149 共用的目标包规则，本 PR 加了对象闭包这一条）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts`（先按依赖闭包 build）→ 11/11 通过，其中第一条断言副本行的 `package_id` 是 `com.example.showcase.custom`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

**The door** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts`).

- Body `{ name, label, package? }`, still closed. An empty or non-string `package` is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` on field `package`, never read as omitted.
- New step 6, landing, after the name checks and before the save:
  - `package` given: the shared rule `newSimilarTargetRefusal` (below) judges it, asked of the source's package and of every object the set grants on (`permissionSetObjectNames`: the `objects` keys, the object half of each `fields` key, each row-level rule's `object`). A refusal answers through `newSimilarTargetRefusalAnswer`, so `packageId` and `docs` reach the envelope's details.
  - omitted, source shipped by a read-only package X: `protocol.ensureCustomizationPackage({ basePackageId: X })`, N-13's body, the pair's only creation path (⛔ no second one). Its refusals keep their own status and code. A protocol with no ensure verb answers 501, never a package-less save.
  - omitted, source in a writable package: that package (the ensure door refuses a writable base, whose changes go into it directly).
  - omitted, environment-authored source: environment-wide, unchanged.
- The save passes the landing as `saveMetaItem`'s own `packageId`. The item still drops `packageId` (`PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS` is unchanged), so `permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal` never sees a body key disagreeing with the row.
- The answer is `{ permissionSet, package, notice }`; `package` is `null` environment-wide. `permissionSetCloneNotice(landing)` puts the landing sentence ahead of the unchanged `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_NOTICE`.
- Order kept: `manage_metadata`, then the walled catalog refusal, both before any read and before the pair is ensured, so a tenant administrator under `isolated` / `group` gets the walled sentence and no pair is created.

**The shared target rule** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/new-similar-target.ts`). Byte-identical to #28149's file at `claude/project-thread-sdqbrt@97489b20` (unknown or read-only → 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`; a closure that does not reach the source's package → 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, through `resolvePackageClosure`), plus one limb this door needs: an optional `objects` list, each judged by the save gate's own closure predicate `narrowObjectsToPackageClosure` (platform/system objects and unpackaged ones admitted; an object no registry holds left to the save). That is what judges an environment-authored source given a target, and a packaged set granting on another package's object. `@objectstack/lint` joins runtime's dependencies for the two walks (the same line #28149 adds). The flow door passes no `objects` (it has no honest object list).

**Contract.** The route ledger lists the door as `server-only` with no `requestSchema` (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`), so no spec schema is invented; the row's note now states the body, the landing rules, both refusals and the answer's `package`. No error code is minted (both codes are registered). Docs: the two pages named on the `Skills-docs:` line.

**Gate roster.** `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` `DISPATCHER_DOMAINS` declares `new-similar-target.ts` `{ handBuilt: 0 }` (the gate reds on an undeclared file in `domains/`); the #28149 thread has the same two lines.

**Test alias.** `packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts` aliases `@objectstack/lint/runtime` to `../lint/src/runtime.ts`, byte-identical to #28149's line, so the rule's tests judge the source (`check:test-source-alias` reds without it once runtime imports the subpath).

**System-context census.** The objects limb hands the registered object to `narrowObjectsToPackageClosure` whole (`{ ...object, name, _packageId }`) rather than reading `isSystem` off it, which `check:system-context-census` reads as an elevation read; the predicate reads the same flags either way.

## Why

Card #28563 (N-20a of epic #28236): a copy made by the clone door belonged to no package, so a customer's change to a shipped set (for example HotCRM's) fell out of the package export. The maintainer's direction on the epic is package-level override, one mechanism for code and Studio, with customizations in `.custom` (ADR-0146 D3/D6). This door now lands its copy there, through N-13's ensure door only.

## Tests

- **Red first** (dogfood, against the unchanged base door, runtime built at base `cd065d36`): 4 of 10 red. The packaged copy landed package-less: `expected undefined to be 'com.example.showcase.custom'` (twice); the environment control's answer had no `package` key; the target case (its fixture ids were then fixed from underscores to hyphens).
- **Green** (dogfood `permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts`, real showcase boot): 11/11. Measured there:
  - the first copy of a showcase set creates `com.example.showcase.custom` (404 before, 200 after), the stored `sys_metadata` row's `package_id` is the pair, its `metadata` has no `packageId`, and the catalog serves the copy with `packageId` = the pair;
  - the second copy reuses it: one pair in `GET /packages`;
  - **Wanted 3, measured:** the pair-bound copy is granted through a position saved by name AND through a direct `sys_user_permission_set` row (`resolveUserAuthzGrants` lists it; the direct leg reads it absent first);
  - a platform set (`member_default`, shipped by the security plugin's manifest, namespace `sys`) lands in its own pair;
  - a writable target declaring the showcase lands there; the showcase itself (read-only) and an unknown id are 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, a writable target declaring nothing is 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, each with no catalog entry and no `sys_metadata` row;
  - an environment-authored source still copies with `package: null` and a row whose `package_id` is null.
- **Unit** (`permission-set-clone.test.ts`, 35/35): the save's `packageId` and the ensure call per landing; pair reuse; environment control (save keys exactly as before, no ensure); writable source; given target in closure, including an environment-authored source; unknown / code-package / `scope: 'cloud'` targets 422 naming the package; out-of-closure by the source's package alone (a `crm` set granting only `sys_user`) and by an object alone (an environment set granting `account`); a platform-only set reachable from any target; empty `package` 400; an ensure refusal keeps its status; no ensure verb 501; walled tenant refused with no ensure call.
- **Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the runtime suite imports the door and the rule from `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run; each restore read blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - ensure bypassed (`const pair = await protocol.ensureCustomizationPackage(...)` → a null pair): 3 red (default landing, pair reuse, ensure refusal);
  - objects limb off (`if (request.objects !== undefined && request.objects.length > 0) {` → `if (false as boolean) {`): 1 red (the environment set given an island target);
  - source-package limb off (`if (sourcePackageId !== undefined && sourcePackageId !== target) {` → `if (false as boolean) {`): the first run was GREEN, because the only fixture for it also tripped the objects limb; I added the `crm`-ships-`sys_user`-only case and re-ran: 1 red.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` on the final head: Test Files 502 passed (502), Tests 8170 passed | 19 skipped (8189).

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② arm.** The claim expected `yes (widening)` with a narrowing arm if `CLAUSE2_ARMS` reads it so. It does: one arm only, and a request that answered 200 now refuses for a package the ensure door cannot pair, so the line is `yes (narrowing)` with the `**BREAKING**` banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker in the changeset. Not measured on a live package: no booted package in the showcase or the platform lacks a namespace (the platform sets pair as `sys_custom`); the refusal path is the ensure door's own, read from its code.
- **Shared helper (order's coordination line).** Agreed with the #28149 card thread: their file location, signature and codes; this PR carries their file byte-identical plus the `objects` limb and the route-envelope roster line. Whichever lands first owns the file; the other merges `origin/main` and takes it.
- **Default closure.** The default landings (`<X>.custom`, the source's writable package) are not asked the target rule: the pair depends on X, and the source already resolved inside its own package. The save into the package is judged by the save door's closure-narrowed authoring gate, as every package save is.
- **Overlap.** PR #28554 edits `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`; this diff touches neither.

## Verification

All on head `40a37314` unless named.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran … --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 124 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 124 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Every family exit 0, `check:type-check-debt` included (`0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number`, under `os-verify-lock`).
- Runtime: typecheck exit 0; tests 502/502 files, 8170 passed | 19 skipped. Unit file `permission-set-clone.test.ts` 35/35.
- Dogfood, after building the runtime at this head: `vitest run test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` → Tests 1 failed | 18 passed (19). The clone file is 11/11; every one of its cases is an HTTP call to `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone` through the real dispatcher (this PR changes that route-ledger row's note). The one red is `route-ledger-live-mount-parity`: `GET /packages/:id/customizations — LEDGERED BUT NOT MOUNTED`, the row #28595 added on `main`; this diff touches neither that row nor its mount.
- Full dogfood on the merged head `56f66311`: Test Files 1 failed | 364 passed | 3 skipped, Tests 2942 passed; the one failed file is the same parity red. On the pre-merge head `76b93c18` (base before #28595): 364 passed | 3 skipped, 2938 tests, no failure.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0; `check-commit-card-trailers` exit 0.
- `origin/main` has moved 7 commits since the last merge; none touches a file in this diff and `git merge-tree` is clean.
